item.howlingwerewolf.wolfsbane_potion.de: Cures werewolves; humans are poisoned for 60 seconds
Brewed from awkward potion and wolfsbane flower
item.howlingwerewolf.central_ritual_alta: The moon-oath heart of the Alpha Trial
One central altar; ordinary altars exactly 3 blocks east, south, west, and north at the same height
Offer an Alpha Badge at the center and one Moonbane Pearl outside at each point; use the center empty-handed
Overworld night, level 10, normal werewolf form, and no other player in the ward; failure returns only the badge
screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf: You are not yet a werewolf.
skill.howlingwerewolf.damage.desc: Each rank increases claw damage by 30%.
skill.howlingwerewolf.defense.desc: Each rank grants 8% natural damage reduction.
skill.howlingwerewolf.speed.desc: Adds 0.02 movement speed per rank while transformed.
skill.howlingwerewolf.resistance.desc: Ranks 1–3 remove Weakness, Poison, and Slowness; rank 4 adds Mining Fatigue and Blindness; rank 5 adds Wither and Darkness.
skill.howlingwerewolf.regeneration.desc: Heals 0.5 health per rank every 2.5 seconds while transformed.
message.howlingwerewolf.infected: A fever pulses outward from the fresh bite...
message.howlingwerewolf.awakened: Night settles over the world. The wolf buried beneath the wound opens its eyes, and strength surges through your limbs.
message.howlingwerewolf.full_moon: The full moon hangs high. An ancient covenant drags you into wolf form, and feral strength awakens with it.
message.howlingwerewolf.moon_sets: Dawn severs the moon's reins. You reclaim your human shape, but the beast's aftershock leaves your limbs heavy.
message.howlingwerewolf.moon_forced: The full moon still holds your blood; tonight, there is no road back to human form.
message.howlingwerewolf.werewolf_on: Bones shift beneath the night. The wolf in your blood opens its eyes, and strength surges through your limbs.
message.howlingwerewolf.human_on: Claws withdraw beneath your skin, but the beast's aftershock leaves your limbs heavy and your hands unsteady.
message.howlingwerewolf.cured: The wolfsbane scours the lycanthropy from your blood.
message.howlingwerewolf.potion_awakened: The draught burns through your veins, waking the wolf within your bones with a surge of newborn strength.
message.howlingwerewolf.reset_unavailabl: Progression reset requires werewolf level 6 or higher.
message.howlingwerewolf.reset_success: Progression reset complete. Level %s; skill points %s; skill-tree points %s.
item.howlingwerewolf.alpha_werewolf_badg: Active while carried anywhere in the hotbar
Werewolf blood: grants 10 base werewolf XP per minute
Werewolf form: prevents one fatal hit; configuration can preserve the badge
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.full_moon: A full moon forces transformation. Wolf form brings brief Strength; returning human brings Weakness, Slowness, and Mining Fatigue.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.armor: Transformed forms cannot equip armor or elytra by default. Armored Instinct permits them only in normal werewolf form; each armor-bearing piece suppresses natural reduction by 25% and werewolf speed/jump bonuses by 17.5%. Zero-armor equipment such as elytra does not apply this penalty. Quadruped and Beast forms never allow equipment.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.fire: While transformed, you take 50% more fire damage.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.diet: While transformed, only meat is edible unless Hard Life is unlocked.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.silver: Werewolves take 50% extra damage from Silver Sword attacks and receive Weakness II.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.progression: Gain experience by killing creatures to advance the skill tree and learn abilities.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.level_scalin: Each level increases base damage and damage reduction.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.quadruped: Quadruped Wolf: unlock it by learning Wildstride Form; gain higher speed and jumping at the cost of slightly lower attack damage.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.beast: Alpha Beast Form: greatly increases attack damage and improves speed, jumping, and damage reduction, but drains hunger faster.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.beast_warnin: This form may affect gameplay balance.
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.title: Reset Werewolf Progression?
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.warning: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.clears: All skill-tree ranks and unlocked skills will be cleared.
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.experience: Current level XP and bonus/admin points will also be cleared.
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.points: After reset: %s skill points / %s skill-tree points
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.title: Trial of the Alpha's Moon-Crown
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.locked: Beast Form: the Moon-Crown is not yet yours
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.intro: Build and awaken the five-altar moon-oath below, then defeat its Watchers and Alpha. The first victory unlocks Beast Form. Repeat Easy/Normal victories return 1 Moonbane Pearl; repeat Hard victories grant 1 Skill Point, 1 Skill-tree Point, and 2 pearls.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.layout: Top view: 1 is central; 2–5 are ordinary altars. Each outer altar is three blocks from 1, with the two gray blocks showing the intervening spaces. Keep all five at one Y level.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.items: Place the Alpha Badge on 1 and one Moonbane Pearl on each outer altar. All four pearls are committed; victory consumes the badge, while failure drops it beside altar 1.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.requirement: Begin at night in the Overworld as a level-10-or-higher normal-form werewolf. No other player may enter the 18-block arena.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.warning: Death, disconnecting, leaving, breaking an altar, or switching to Peaceful fails the trial and releases the ward. The ward repels anything at its edge.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.damage.desc: Each rank increases claw damage by 30%.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.moon_rend.des: Each rank makes claw attacks deal additional damage equal to 0.6% of the target's maximum health.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.defense.desc: Each rank grants 8% natural damage reduction.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.speed.desc: Adds 0.02 movement speed per rank while transformed.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.resistance.de: Ranks 1–3 remove Weakness, Poison, and Slowness; rank 4 also removes Mining Fatigue and Blindness; rank 5 also removes Wither and Darkness.
Heals 0.5 health per rank every 2.5 seconds while transformed.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.jump.desc: Each rank adds 1.2 blocks of jump height.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.knockback_res: Each rank grants 50% knockback resistance; maximum rank fully prevents knockback.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.fall_resistan: The first rank reduces fall damage by 50%; the next ignores the entire fall-damage process.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.lifesteal.des: Heals 10%/15%/20% of final melee damage without exceeding maximum health.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.satiety.desc: Reduces transformed hunger use from 1.5x to 1.33x, 1.16x, then 1.0x.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.claw_efficien: Each rank increases empty-claw reach and adds one level of Looting to claw kills.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.hunting_maste: Kill XP becomes 60%, then 75%, of the victim's maximum health.
ability.howlingwerewolf.summon_wolf_spir: Press N to summon five spirits that follow and assist you for four minutes, with a 60-second cooldown.
ability.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_form.d: Press G to switch between normal werewolf and quadruped wolf form. Speed and jumping increase greatly, attack damage decreases slightly, and the quadruped cannot wear equipment.
Press R while transformed for powerful recovery, absorption, gradually decaying Resistance, and combat buffs. A short period of weakness and fatigue follows. Cooldown: 4 minutes; Resistance skills can clear the penalties.
ability.howlingwerewolf.armored_instinct: Allows armor or elytra only in normal werewolf form. Each armor-bearing piece suppresses natural reduction by 25% and werewolf movement/jump bonuses by 17.5%; zero-armor equipment does not.
ability.howlingwerewolf.beast_mode.desc: Permanently unlocked after the first Alpha victory; press H to toggle it. Beast Form cannot wear equipment.
ability.howlingwerewolf.beast_mode.warni: Only one who tears the Moon-Crown from its bearer may wake the beast buried deepest in the blood.
Keeps one hotbar slot empty; items move only into the main inventory or other hotbar slots, and cannot be picked up when those are full.
ability.howlingwerewolf.long_claws.desc: Empty-hand attacks deal half damage to nearby enemies.
ability.howlingwerewolf.tool_claws.desc: While transformed, empty claws mine like iron-tier pickaxes, axes, and shovels and can harvest iron-tier blocks.
ability.howlingwerewolf.fire_claws.desc: Empty-hand attacks while transformed apply the equivalent of Fire Aspect II.
ability.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite.desc: Press B while transformed and empty-handed to bite the aimed target for 1.8x current claw damage and inflict Weakness II, Slowness III, Hunger, and Poison for 15 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.meat_only: A true beast rejects bland vegetarian fare.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_on: The last chain of reason snaps. An ancient beast tears its way through flesh and bone.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_off: Rage sinks beneath the blood. The beast folds away its fangs and yields the body to the wolf that still remembers reason.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_locked: The beast at the bottom of your blood still sleeps. Take the Moon-Crown in the Alpha Trial first.
message.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_on: Your spine lowers to the earth and four limbs find an older rhythm. The wind lays the wild road beneath your paws.
message.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_off: Forepaws leave the dust as bone lifts toward a human outline. The rhythm of the chase still echoes in your chest.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_on: Moonblood boils within your heart. Wounds close, and a silver tide floods every bone with strength.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_cooldo: Your moonblood is still cooling; the silver tide will answer again in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_crash: The borrowed moonfire dies. Weakness and weight crawl through your cooling blood.
message.howlingwerewolf.spirit_cooldown: Wolf spirits can be summoned again in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_cool: Bloody Bite will be ready in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_no_t: Aim at a living enemy within claw reach to use Bloody Bite.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_requ: Bloody Bite requires an empty main hand.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.overworld_: No alien sky will witness this oath. The Alpha Trial belongs to the Overworld alone.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.night_only: The sun still watches the altar. Wait for night, and let the moon witness your challenge.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.already_ac: The altar's oath has not yet fallen silent. A second hunt cannot be awakened here.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.level_requ: Your wolf-blood cannot yet bear the Moon-Crown. Return at werewolf level 10.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.form_requi: The Moon-Crown answers only a challenger in normal werewolf form. Put aside human skin, Wildstride, and Beast Form.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.single_pla: The moon-oath recognizes one challenger. Ask every other player to leave the ward.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.structure_: The altar constellation or its offerings are incomplete. The Moonbane Pearls cannot find their path to the badge.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.begin: The badge rises from stone and four Moonbane Pearls climb silver paths—the moon-oath has heard your name.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.hunters_ar: A pillar of light wounds the night. Seven Silver-Oath Watchers enter the ward to weigh your wolf-blood with steel.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_arri: The final silver blade falls, and the Moon-Crowned ruler steps from shadow. The last hunt begins.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_says: %s: “My brothers, my pack—heed the Moon-Crown's command! Come to my aid and tear this usurper apart!”
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_revi: %s: “The Moon-Crown has not changed hands.” A death-howl tears through the ward as moonbane fire hauls the Alpha back to its feet.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.failed: Your challenge falters. The silver paths gutter out and the ward tears open; four Moonbane Pearls sink into darkness, while the Alpha Badge falls beside the central altar to await another oath.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.victory_fi: The Moon-Crowned Alpha falls, and the beast asleep in your blood opens its eyes. The oath yields 1 Werewolf Potion, 1 Moonbane Pearl, and 1 Alpha Badge.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.victory_re: The old Alpha falls again. The moon-oath returns 1 Moonbane Pearl to your hand.
The old Alpha falls at last. Its battle memory floods your sinew and instinct: +1 Skill Point, +1 Skill-tree Point, and 2 Moonbane Pearls.
